Identify the exponential growth model over $10$ years from beginning of 2005 to beginning of 2015 ($2015 - 2005 = 10$):
$$\text{Value} = 10000(1 + 0.05)^{10} = 10000(1.05)^{10}$$

Evaluate and round to the nearest $100$ dollars:
$$\text{Value} = 10000 \times 1.628895 = 16288.95 \approx 16300 \text{ dollars}$$

Find the first term $a = S_1$ by substituting $n = 1$ into the sum formula $S_n = \frac{1}{2}n(3n + 7)$:
$$a = S_1 = \frac{1}{2}(1)(3(1) + 7) = \frac{1}{2}(10) = 5$$

Find the sum of the first two terms $S_2$ by substituting $n = 2$:
$$S_2 = \frac{1}{2}(2)(3(2) + 7) = 1(6 + 7) = 13$$

Determine the second term $T_2$ and common difference $d$:
$$T_2 = S_2 - S_1 = 13 - 5 = 8$$
$$d = T_2 - T_1 = 8 - 5 = 3$$
$$\text{First term } a = 5, \quad \text{Common difference } d = 3$$
